profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer @ Chekhub
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer who builds production systems where reliability and security are not optional. I am focused on building out the back-end systems at Chekhub, from the cloud, our database, our microservices, to whatever we need to do to get our customers what they need. At IBM I worked on everything from Windows drivers to setting up ML threat detection at Guardium. While I was at Centene we handled HIPAA compliance at an enormous scale. I have worked across the stack and across languages with things like Go, Node, Java, Mongo, and even REXX (a scripting language for COBOL). 
When I am not at work I have been contributing to mechanistic interpretability of LLMs. I think some of it is really interesting, if you'd like to see more check out my website here: akashpa.tel.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Engineering workforce-enablement and operations management for critical industries

Building a Node backend split across many microservices used by frontline teams in mission-critical industries

Rebuilt training system from the ground up to allow companies to better track their work force readiness to the granularity of an individual

Help ensure the service is ready when technicians hit low connectivity environments so they can continue getting their assignments accomplished

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St. Louis City County, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Handled sensitive healthcare PHI through a major technology migration while maintaining HIPAA compliance and security throughout.
 
Built cloud-native software on a React / Kafka / MongoDB / Go stack.
 
Trained as scrum master and led scrum lifting team communication and output.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built Guardium, IBM's data-protection platform that lets security teams automatically discover and analyze sensitive-data environments across an organization.
 
Developed a TensorFlow model to classify and locate personally identifiable information at scale, storing metadata to support GDPR compliance; used Python-based ML to flag malicious actors and neutralize threats across database systems.
 
Implemented Go backend microservices integrated with Kafka pipelines and the frontend, processing security data end to end.
 
Automated 360 tests across 30 VMs running legacy scripts, cutting ~8 hours/day from Jenkins build time.
 
Led a exploratory team building an ML-based database-security system, owning both delivery and mentorship.

positions.title: IT Technical Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Essential code upgrades for the Asia Pacific Rollout of My Cat Travel Expense on the mainframe. 
Impact Analysis for SAP Vertex update for internal Caterpillar systems.
Windows 10 Preparedness testing, documentation, and server updates.
Java software designing.
